items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: I took up clarinet and learned it from rap. I sat next to rap for a year

ctx.x: She was younger than you are.

Yeah, she's a year under me. And Vic, getting back to Vic, I thought Vic would have been a real fine tenor man, but he just left it fall on the wayside. I took up clarinet and learned it from rap. I sat next to rap for a year, but I never could learn rap style because, for instance, I used to ask rap, how did you make this lick? How did you make this break? And he used to call me Oibs. And he used to say, well, Oibs, I really can't tell you. I'll make them when I get to them, which was true with rap. Rap never…
You can tell that from the Tin Roof Blues. There's three masters. That's right.
